shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عثمان بن خثيم

notes: «وأبو أحمد قالا حدثنا سفيان»: Bishr and the second Abu Ahmad are one co-transmitter level before Sufyan (rule 2); both routes meet at Sufyan, and the names after him are the shared tail
«وقال محمود في حديثه» is a wording variant, left out; «ح» is a taḥwīl marker
